thread:
alex: QuasarEdge is ready to kick off EAP. They asked for our bench harness, NDA redline, and marketplace SKU guidance. Shipping earliest next Wed. Who can drive this? @monica?
monica: I can manage logistics and marketplace. Ops window?
ops-bot: LAB: receive Tue/Thu only. ACCEPTED_CARRIERS=FedEx,DHL. MAX_WEIGHT=30kg. Please attach chain-of-custody (COA) PDF.
monica: Ok lab window noted. I'll request COA from QuasarEdge. Claire, Legal will need their NDA redline.
claire: Please share redline link when uploaded. We'll push for a mutual embargo (10 business days) and require synthetic prompts + aggregated metrics only.
june-quasar: Uploading NDA redline now: https://quasar-files.s3/nda_redline_v1.pdf. We can ship Wed. We'll attach a test container to a temporary bucket after NDA signed. Our default stress profile is `--threads=36 --seq=3072`. We've seen frequency stepping on long soaks.
ryan: Research: frequency stepping/thermal ramp could bias our normalized metrics. Proposal: 2 cold runs (cache off) per model/quant, 1 warm run for latency, 1x 40m soak capturing telemetry. We'll capture p50/p95, sustained tokens/s, power(W), and max GPU temp.
monica: Marketplace SKU idea: QUASAR-EAP-1 / region:us-west-2. We'll need a short partner blurb, logo (svg), and supported model flavors. PM: do we include performance badges or raw numbers only?
ryan: PM prefers raw numbers in the listing, no qualitative badges. Keep listing factual: p95@2k, sustained tokens/s@4k, energy-per-token.
claire: Legal note: we will not accept raw logs with prompts. Harness must scrub/replace tokens and only publish aggregated counters + anonymized flamegraphs. Add a small addendum to the NDA.
ops-bot: NOTE: lab_accept_window=Tue/Thu. Please ensure shipping label ETA matches. Failure to schedule will return the package.
june-quasar: Understood — we'll aim for Wed ship to hit Thu lab receive. We'll provide serial numbers and driver manifest. We can preload drivers if Ops prefers.
ryan: Bench harness plan (we'll push to bench repo):
```
./bench_quasar.sh \
  --model redwood/fast-3b,redwood/fast-7b \
  --seq 3072 \
  --batch 1 \
  --quant fp16,int8 \
  --threads 36 \
  --collect gpu_power,gpu_temp,gpu_freq,mem_bw \
  --soak 2400 \
  --synthetic-prompts true
```
ryan: We'll run: 3x short cold iterations (cache disabled) per config, then 1 warm pass, then 1x 40m soak. Parser will compute p50/p95, tokens_per_sec (sustained window), avg_power, max_temp.
monica: SI partners want a mini quickstart for on-prem integrators. Can someone own an SI quickstart (networking + kernel modules + model pinning)? @alex?
alex: I can draft the SI quickstart. Will include firewall rules, container runtime notes, and driver/kernel checks. Need partner to confirm kernel version.
june-quasar: Kernel version is 5.19.x. We'll attach driver manifest in the S3 link after NDA.
claire: NDA redline reviewed. Legal will accept mutual 10-business-day embargo with explicit publish sign-off from both parties. Also requiring the data-handling addendum. I'll send the updated NDA by EOD.
ryan: Telemetry handling: we'll collect metrics via Prometheus exporters; raw traces will be scrubbed and only aggregated counters stored. Add a mapping doc for metrics names so partners can align.
monica: Marketing: request logos (svg), one-paragraph partner use case, and an exec quote if we do a joint blog. Marketing needs assets 10 business days before embargo end.
june-quasar: We'll provide logos and a quote after NDA. Exec prefers the embargo window be 2 weeks so they can coordinate PR. Are we okay with 10 business days (2 weeks)?
claire: 10 business days works (roughly 2 weeks). We'll add a 3-day review buffer for legal sign-off on quotes.
ops-bot: ACTIONS: Please attach COA and schedule shipping to match lab window.
monica: Action items: 
- alex: SI quickstart draft + network diagram (due Fri 3450002000)
- ryan: bench harness + parser + soak dashboard (due Thu 3450001800)
- monica: marketplace SKU draft + listing PR (due Thu 3450002200)
- claire: finalize NDA + data-handling addendum and send to partner (due Wed 3450001200)
- june-quasar: upload signed NDA, container image, logo, driver manifest (ETA Wed ship)

alex: I'll slot a 30m kickoff for Wed after NDA is signed. Keep the thread for status updates. Thanks all :rocket:
